name: Mark of The Blade
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level antipaladin 3, bloodrager 4, cleric/oracle 3, death mage 3, lathspell 2, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 4, spiritualist 3, witch 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You touch the target creature and a mark of a bladed weapon appears on their skin. Anytime the target takes slashing or piercing damage they are dealt 1d4 extra damage. This damage is increased on a critical by 1d4 for each multiple. For example, a critical hit from a greataxe would deal 3d4 extra damage.
